example_sentences_in_bangla: সে নাথবতী অনাধবৎ, পরিবারের জন্য সবকিছু করে কিন্তু নিজের ভাগ্যে কখনো সুখ পায় না।
এই বাড়ির বধূ নাথবতী অনাধবৎ, সমৃদ্ধি আনে কিন্তু নিজে দুঃখী।
example_sentences_in_english: She is like a wife without a husband and an orphan; she brings prosperity to the family but remains unfortunate herself.
The bride of this house is the household's Lakshmi but unfortunate, bringing wealth yet enduring sorrow.
history: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali views on women's roles in sustaining family prosperity while facing personal hardships, possibly originating from folklore emphasizing sacrifice.
note: References the Hindu goddess Lakshmi, symbolizing domestic wealth and well-being.
